title: extension
description: The offer of a [domain].core, `offer/offer.yml` (extension.md R25), and in $defs the release record of an extension, `release.yml` (R32). Version, licence and attribution are not fields of the offer: the release, LICENSE and knowledge/sources.yml.

id.description: the extension's id, the domain; referred to as <library>/<id>

kind.description: the kind of commons the extension is made for

gives.description: what a commons of the kind gains from it

asks.description: what it asks back: evidence, a Body to hold what is adopted, a loop to keep it alive

made_in.description: the [domain].core and the commit the release was made from, owner/repo@sha

changed.description: which parts changed, so that a change of served depth never reads as a change of what is installed

renames.description: old offered id -> new id, or null where it is retired; required content for a major version
